name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.4 degrees south of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 19 times in 6 visits over 20 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 21 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 29 hours starting 2025-07-19, at wavelengths from 0.83 to 1.52 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
